draft.title: Taccuino del giorno · 23 novembre 2026
draft.excerpt: Una giornata ricca di movimenti nel vivaio rossonero e reti decisive in cadetteria, mentre i prestiti si moltiplicano tra i giovani talenti italiani.
draft.excerptEn: A busy day of movements in the Rossoneri youth sector and decisive goals in Serie B, as loans multiply among Italy's young talents.
draft.bodyIt:
**Francesco Camarda e Mattia Liberali**
Il Milan potrebbe spedire Camarda in prestito sotto la guida di Amorim, mentre rimane da risolvere la spinosa situazione di Liberali in casa rossonera. [fonte](https://news.google.?oc=5)

**Francesco Coppola**
La Ligue 1 arride al giovane talento: il numero 10 del Paris FC illumina il campo nella goleada per 4-0 contro l'Angers con una prestazione di spicco. [fonte](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiowFBVV95cUxPSnl5RVU5OUdKSzhoMVZ4RE5PdWtiUGtNR2RYTnlMQjZpZW1YNEliUVQ5aUVRaVl3UVVpZlZ5U0NmOWY1ajhpSlgtVENTbm1DWDJEVm02OW9PZHhRMWlPeDg4U0QzS1lXQXFJYXRPaTd4SHNlNHBqZi1ZcHlHai1oRW1USm54YWtQc3FtTDV5ZEtvc0phMkljdWJ2NmpKdEloUHB3?oc=5)

**Giuseppe Ambrosino**
Il talento azzurro continua a brillare in prestito al Modena: quarto gol stagionale in Serie B, e questa volta arriva da una punizione di rara bellezza. [fonte](https://news.google.?oc=5)

**Tommaso Rubino**
La Carrarese centra un successo pesantissimo in cadetteria grazie alla rete decisiva di Rubino contro l'Entella. [fonte](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixgFBVV95cUxObmw5VURZSTZDT3lkZlktRkMzajdCTno2Y1VLUzNqTlJWNnBDX0NJVV9EVW1lZS00Wkl6T1A0bkFkOEtGQU82Y2FlMWRFYkd3Wnh6cWtrVy1fZ2Q5eGVTWVV5aVV3Q2x2b3RSNWlDMjRTaFFDVU1MZzFrN3lFZS1rWjhwWm5yblZCX2RaRWpkeGxNX0d1QzZjXzlpanhQSl9senBvQ1g0Q29jcFFleG5GSzcyNFlCZHZLTE1MYVRkdVlEclBBaHc?oc=5)

**Mattia Angelicchio**
Il Milan Primavera continua a vincere: il gol di Angelicchio decide la sfida contro la Lazio in un match che conferma i progressi della formazione rossonera. [fonte](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMieEFVX3lxTFBvOW8wZ3hkdDdTQk16VGNadzMtaF9vT2p2eEpSQnNxdVJEa0RWckhJb2ZmX0w0QVN3OXdob2R6Y2lWZjRndzhmNTQ3ekZqNk9DSTczdUdTZ3N0eGF4bm5OOG9wQkRUaVdlSTdEMjJsekFXMHpOSDlMZw?oc=5)

In una giornata di spolverate importanti per i classe 2000-2010, il movimento giovanile italiano dimostra di continuare a produrre talenti su più fronti.
draft.bodyEn:
**Francesco Camarda and Mattia Liberali**
AC Milan could send Camarda out on loan under Amorim's management, while the tricky situation of Liberali in the Rossoneri academy remains unsolved. [source](https://news.google.?oc=5)

**Francesco Coppola**
Ligue 1 continues to suit the young talent well: the number 10 of Paris FC shines on the pitch in the 4-0 rout against Angers with a stellar performance. [source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiowFBVV95cUxPSnl5RVU5OUdKSzhoMVZ4RE5PdWtiUGtNR2RYTnlMQjZpZW1YNEliUVQ5aUVRaVl3UVVpZlZ5U0NmOWY1ajhpSlgtVENTbm1DWDJEVm02OW9PZHhRMWlPeDg4U0QzS1lXQXFJYXRPaTd4SHNlNHBqZi1ZcHlHai1oRW1USm54YWtQc3FtTDV5ZEtvc0phMkljdWJ2NmpKdEloUHB3?oc=5)

**Giuseppe Ambrosino**
The Azzurri prospect continues to shine on loan at Modena: fourth Serie B goal of the season, and this time it comes from a free kick of rare beauty. [source](https://news.google.?oc=5)

**Tommaso Rubino**
Carrarese secure a heavyweight victory in the second tier thanks to Rubino's decisive strike against Entella. [source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixgFBVV95cUxObmw5VURZSTZDT3lkZlktRkMzajdCTno2Y1VLUzNqTlJWNnBDX0NJVV9EVW1lZS00Wkl6T1A0bkFkOEtGQU82Y2FlMWRFYkd3Wnh6cWtrVy1fZ2Q5eGVTWVV5aVV3Q2x2b3RSNWlDMjRTaFFDVU1MZzFrN3lFZS1rWjhwWm5yblZCX2RaRWpkeGxNX0d1QzZjXzlpanhQSl9senBvQ1g0Q29jcFFleG5GSzcyNFlCZHZLTE1MYVRkdVlEclBBaHc?oc=5)

**Mattia Angelicchio**
AC Milan Primavera continues its winning run: Angelicchio's goal decides the showdown against Lazio in a match that confirms the progress of the Rossoneri youth side. [source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMieEFVX3lxTFBvOW8wZ3hkdDdTQk16VGNadzMtaF9vT2p2eEpSQnNxdVJEa0RWckhJb2ZmX0w0QVN3OXdob2R6Y2lWZjRndzhmNTQ3ekZqNk9DSTczdUdTZ3N0eGF4bm5OOG9wQkRUaVdlSTdEMjJsekFXMHpOSDlMZw?oc=5)

In a day of significant updates for the 2000-2010 generations, Italy's youth movement continues to demonstrate its ability to produce talent across multiple fronts.
